open_points.subject: import_snapshot audit timestamp
open_points.text: - import_snapshot: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord
open_points.question: The audit operation writes an AuditRecord with occurred_at, but neither append_audit nor AuditIntent accepts the single instant read by import_snapshot; which passage must change, or how can append_audit be made to use that exact instant?

open_points.subject: import_snapshot accepted snapshot timestamps
open_points.text: - import_snapshot: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: - _build_approved_snapshot: [PROVENANCE] MUST copy publication identity/content, actor service principal and key_version, fingerprint, and received_at into a new immutable snapshot without Registry name/address fields.
open_points.question: ApprovedEstimateSnapshot content includes publication approved_at and published_at timestamps, which must be copied rather than replaced by the single current instant; must “every timestamp it writes” be narrowed to operation-generated timestamps?
